speaker: Featherwings
text: The project cannot be realised in this part of the Conan Sea. It is too close to the wetland — protected under the Ramsar Convention — which hosts more than 20,000 migratory birds that rest there on their long journeys.

speaker: Featherwings
text: Among them is the red knot (Calidris canutus), a critically endangered species listed in Annex I of the Bonn Convention. Construction noise could drive the red knot out permanently, and there is a real risk of birds colliding with turbine blades.

speaker: Featherwings
text: If we go ahead with the project here, we negatively impact SDG 15, and Arcadia breaches its obligations under both the Ramsar and Bonn Conventions.

speaker: Legal Advisor
text: Featherwings is right that Arcadia has obligations to protect migratory birds under the Bonn Convention — especially endangered species like the red knot. The Ramsar COP has explicitly called on parties to act with precaution when developing wind turbine parks.

speaker: Legal Advisor
text: Arcadia is also obliged to protect the wetland's ecological character under the Ramsar Convention. There is one exception: a state may restrict a listed wetland's boundaries if it is 'in its urgent national interest'. That bar is high.
